posts.text:
Violent criminals are walking free under cashless bail policies.

Our No Bailouts for Cashless Bail Jurisdictions Act cuts off federal funding to jurisdictions substantially eliminating cash bail as a condition of pretrial release for serious offenses.

If a city or state wants federal taxpayer dollars, it must hold criminals accountable and keep dangerous people off the streets.

Our bill is simple: eliminate cash bail, lose federal funding.
